verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Devin working in a PR-centric git workflow. Auto-Fix responds to review comments and iterates on CI failures so PRs move toward merge-ready quality, which implies Devin pushes commits to PRs. It also has full repo access in its VM and implements tickets end-to-end. However, no cited doc explicitly describes staging changes, writing commit messages, creating branches, or opening new pull requests. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of branch creation, commit message authoring, staging, and PR opening, plus independent hands-on corroboration of the git/PR workflow.
